content:
Anna (PM): Quick sync — marketplace launch readiness checklist. Need final asset owners, embargo windows, and any regional holdouts (EU/JP).
Mike (Partnerships): I can take vendor badge assets and the hardware partner images.
Leo (Marketing): I'll own press + blog timing. Can we get a hard go/no-go by EOD Friday? :calendar:
Sara (Docs): I'll handle localized landing copy for FR/DE/JP. Need the final hero copy and CTA mapping.
Raj (Cloud Sales): We'll need marketplace SKU mapping and pricing fields for GCP/Azure — that's blocked until legal finishes T&Cs.
Tina (SI): SI integration runbook is passing internal tests, but we expect two more days of partner acceptance tests.
Anna (PM): Good. Two asks: 1) someone to own embargo windows per region, 2) a single source-of-truth timeline that includes docs/marketing/ops and SI cutover.
Mike (Partnerships): I nominate myself for embargo windows. I'll coordinate with partners for +/- 24h slack.
Leo (Marketing): I'll publish a shared timeline doc. Draft link: https://redwood.team/marketplace/timeline-draft (will update with final times).
Sara (Docs): Ping on hero copy — putting options inline: 
Option A: "Start building with high-performance LLM inference — deploy in minutes."
Option B: "Production-grade LLM inference, predictable latency & cost."
CTA mapping: [Get started] -> hosted sign-up, [Request demo] -> sales form
Anna (PM): Leaning Option B for enterprise SEO. Sara, localizers need strings by tomorrow 3pm PT.
Sara (Docs): Got it. I'll upload the i18n file to the shared drive and add screenshots for the landing layouts.
Raj (Cloud Sales): For GCP/Azure listings I need the SKU matrix by Thu EOD. Mike, can partner legal speed review?
Mike (Partnerships): I'll nudge legal. If not complete, fallback is to list without pricing ("contact sales") for those regions.
Tina (SI): Regarding the integration cutover — propose a staged rollout: SI customers opt in for week 1; open to all in week 3. That gives us time for hotfixes.
Leo (Marketing): Staged rollout is fine. We'll time the press embargo to the public open (week 3) but do a partner announcement in week 1.
Anna (PM): Important: we must show performance benchmarks on the landing. Who can supply a concise chart + caption?
Raj (Cloud Sales): Eng-runtime can deliver a trimmed chart (latency vs throughput) by Fri.
Sara (Docs): I'll put the chart into the landing and alt text for accessibility.
Mike (Partnerships): Hardware partners need 3 image variants (hero, product detail, logo). Deadline Thu noon.
Tina (SI): Also share the integration test vectors: auth, tenant provisioning, kv cache warmup. Small snippet: 
POST /provision
payload: {tenant_id, model_version, region}
Leo (Marketing): We'll include a short technical explainer for platform engineers on the landing — 2 paragraphs, no deep code.
Anna (PM): Who's owning the roll call for final signoff (legal, security, eng-runtime, marketing, docs, partnerships)?
Mike (Partnerships): I'll create the signoff checklist and ping owners.
DeployBot: Release window candidate set to 2026-05-07T14:00:00Z. Please confirm.
Anna (PM): That window looks OK assuming legal clears by Thu. Action items recap:
- Mike: embargo windows + vendor assets + signoff doc (owner)
- Leo: single timeline doc + press/blog cadence + partner announcement text
- Sara: localized copy + i18n file + landing alt text + add chart
- Raj: SKU matrix + performance chart intake + coordinate with eng-runtime
- Tina: SI runbook final tests + test vectors + staged rollout plan
- Eng-runtime (cc): finalize benchmark chart by Fri
Mike (Partnerships): I'll post updates to the timeline doc and tag owners as tasks.
Leo (Marketing): I'll lock press embargo content and send PR kit to partners once legal confirms.
Sara (Docs): Uploading i18n in 2 hours.
Anna (PM): If anything slips, call it out in the timeline doc with a proposed mitigation. Thanks all — quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT?
Tina (SI): 10am PT works for me.
Raj (Cloud Sales): Same.
Mike (Partnerships): Ack.
Leo (Marketing): 👍
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-06T17:00:00Z — full-team preflight check.
Anna (PM): Closing thread — will follow up with the signoff doc link soon.
